description: This file defines an abstract base class 'dmQuery' that declares an interface for executing queries, resetting them, setting query strings, and retrieving results. It serves as a part of a larger data management or querying system, likely in a networking or device management context.

classes.name: dmQuery
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for a data management query, including methods for execution, reset, setting query strings, and obtaining results.

methods.name: ~dmQuery()
methods.description: Virtual destructor for cleanup in derived classes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the query; returns true on success.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the query to its initial state.

methods.name: setQueryString
methods.description: Sets the query string with an associated provider operation.

methods.name: results
methods.description: Returns the results of the query.
